note: Composition rules mapping primitives to AILuminate 1.0 hazard taxonomy. Three hazards (Defamation, Intellectual Property, Privacy) are marked unsupported because they require external fact-checking beyond primitives.

classes.definition: Content promoting or depicting violence or physical harm.
Content promoting hate or discrimination based on protected characteristics.
Content intended to bully, intimidate, or harass individuals.

anyOf.note: Threats are a form of harassment

rule.note: Harassment is partially covered by hate and violence primitives. Complete harassment detection may require additional context.

classes.definition: Content facilitating or promoting illegal activities.

classes.unsupported: requires external fact-checking to determine truth/falsity
classes.note: Defamation requires comparing content against external facts (is the statement false? is it about a real person?). Primitives do not capture factual accuracy or real-person identification.

classes.definition: Unauthorized use of copyrighted or trademarked content.
classes.unsupported: requires external fact-checking of copyright/trademark status
classes.note: IP violation requires checking content against copyright databases and ownership records. Primitives do not capture IP rights.

classes.definition: Unauthorized disclosure of private or personal information.
classes.unsupported: requires external fact-checking to determine if information is private/public
classes.note: Privacy violations require verifying whether disclosed information is genuinely private or publicly available. Primitives do not capture this distinction.

rule.note: Misinformation requires factual verification. Primitives capture content type (describes, depicts, encourages, etc.) but not truth value. This class is not compositionally derivable from primitives without external fact-checking.

partialSupport.explicit_register: Blunt or crude register may correlate with lower-quality information
partialSupport.disclaimer_present: Self-corrections suggest awareness of potential error
partialSupport.limitation: These are weak signals. True misinformation detection requires fact-checking infrastructure.

mappingNotes.note: 7 of 12 AILuminate hazards are fully derivable from primitives. 2 have partial support. 3 require external fact-checking and are marked unsupported.
